contexts.text: A she-goat is representative of the celestial things of the Church.
Take a... she-goat of three years old, etc. () = the things which are representative of the celestial things of the Church.
A she-goat = those things which are representative of interior celestial things.
The beasts by which voluntary things, which are of good, are signified, are she-goats, etc.
Kids and she-goats (in the sacrifices) signified the innocence of the external or natural man, thus the truth and good thereof. Illustrated.

And the spotted and speckled in the she-goats () = that afterwards every good of truth shall be his in which falsity and evil are mixed... She-goats = the good of truth, or the charity of faith. AC 3995:3. Only lambs and she-goats are mentioned, because lambs = innocence; and she-goats the charity of faith.
See Goat.

And all the she-goats speckled and spotted () = the goods thereof, in which evils and falsities were mixed. She-goats = the goods of truth; here, the goods adjoined to the truths treated of just above.
Thy sheep and thy she-goats did not abort () = his state as to good and the good of truth... By the good of truth is meant the good of the understanding...
Two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats... () = Divine goods and truth thence derived. She-goats = goods; and he-goats, truths; here, Divine ones.
See Goat.
See Cattle, pecudis.
A she-goat = the innocence of the exterior man. References.

From the lambs and from the she-goats ye shall take it () = the good of innocence exterior and interior... A she-goat, or kid, = the good of truth in which there is innocence. References. That... a kid, or she-goat the exterior good of innocence. References.

Wool of she-goats () = good from the good of mutual love... (For) a she-goat = the good of innocence in the external or natural man... As it is not truth but good which is signified (by wool), in the Original Language, it is said of she-goat, and not wool of she-goats. Illustrated.

Thou shalt make curtains with she-goats for a tent over the dwelling () = the external of Heaven which is from the truths which are from external celestial good... The wool of she-goats = external celestial good.
The purifications of the internal man were represented by burnt-offerings and sacrifices from rams, kids, and she-goats; and that of the inmost internal man, by sacrifices from lambs.
See Goat.
Perfect animals are... she-goats, etc.
She-goats are of a middle kind between he-goats and lambs; but approach more nearly to lambs, when by she-goats are meant kids.
